Name: Custom Schedule Keys (CSK)
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
Custom Schedule Keys allows mod authors to define specific keys that the game will check for when loading an NPC's daily schedule before it checks any of the vanilla keys. These custom schedule keys will apply only under the conditions you specify, allowing you more freedom in deciding where an NPC should go on any given day, in case the existing vanilla keys are not specific enough for what you want.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Usage For Players[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own. There is no benefit to installing this as a user if another mod that you are using does not require it.
